summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments on PR #291 in the cipher-box repo, addressing each thread appropriately and pushing a fix.
summary.outcome: Identified two unresolved CodeRabbit threads: one false positive (wget→curl change was correct) and one valid gitignore issue. Fixed the .gitignore to stop tracking generated test files while preserving static fixtures, committed, pushed, and resolved both threads.

repo: The someguy container image has curl available but NOT wget — healthcheck commands must use curl.
tests/e2e has static fixture files (test-image.png, .gitkeep) committed to git that must remain tracked; generated test files should be gitignored.
createTestImageFile in tests/e2e/utils/test-files.ts copies from a static test-image.png fixture rather than generating from scratch.

code.finding: Was incorrectly ignoring static fixture files; fixed to only ignore generated files while keeping test-image.png and .gitkeep tracked.
createTestImageFile depends on a committed static test-image.png fixture file.

workflow: CodeRabbit automated review comments can be incorrect — always verify by inspecting the actual container image or environment before accepting suggestions.
When resolving PR threads, triage validity before implementing: check the actual runtime environment (Dockerfile, running containers) to confirm whether a suggestion is valid.

friction: The someguy container was not running (branch not yet deployed), requiring a Dockerfile inspection to verify curl availability instead of checking a live container.
CodeRabbit flagged the wget→curl change as a regression when it was actually the correct fix, requiring extra investigation to confirm.
